description: the man of the reference picture riding: the creator of worlds, warm brown skin, long dark brown hair and a short dark brown beard, a wise strong face in clean profile, eyes glowing white, a crown of white crystal shining with light, long robes of deep cosmic black and dark blue full of tiny stars with golden trim and golden nebula patterns, a golden ochre tunic, a dark violet lining, a long starry cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, brown boots, no staff, no orbiting worlds, no ring of runes and nothing in the hands but the reins; sitting tall and upright astride a saddle that is not drawn, the back straight, not squatting and not crouching, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing right, the head, chest and hips turned fully to the right; both forearms reaching forward, the two hands together in front of the body holding short reins that end just in front of the hands; only the near leg showing and only one foot in the whole picture: the thigh lying forward and level from the hip to the knee, the knee bent at a right angle, the lower leg hanging vertically straight down from the knee, one whole foot at the bottom with the toes pointing right; the cloak and any long hair hanging down behind the back, not spread out; the far leg completely hidden and not drawn at all, no second boot and no second foot; the whole figure from the top of the crystal crown to the sole of the foot inside the picture with room around it; nothing under the rider; isolated figure on a plain background

references.usage: the character's look: this same man, his face, hair, beard, crystal crown, starry robes and colours, drawn the same way; not his standing pose and not the staff, the orbiting worlds and the ring of runes
